title: Stage 1: The Outskirts
description: A rogue bandit attacks at the entrance to the abandoned martial dojo.

title: Stage 2: Whispering Bamboo
description: An acrobatic ninja strikes from the mist among blood-stained trees.

title: Stage 3: The Fortress Gate
description: The stoic Iron Guard defends the inner sanctum with an impenetrable stance.

title: Stage 4: Moonlit Crypt
description: The lethal Night Reaper descends to reap the souls of challengers.

title: Stage 5: Shadow Apex
description: Confront the legendary Shadow Master atop the crumbling celestial temple.
